intent: Compact stroke-free composer-toolbar pill that shows the active model and opens the model menu; the trigger control only.
guidance: Render one per composer as the trigger for the model menu: the pill shows the active model and reports aria-haspopup="menu", but the menu itself is host-owned (a PopoverMenu the host wires up), so keep placement, options, and selection there. Pass the committed provider label as `value` (e.g. Auto, Claude, OpenAI) — the selected provider travels with the turn, so reflect the real selection here, never a guess. Route `onClick` to open the host menu and set `disabled` when no menu can open, which suppresses onClick and dims the pill. Don't recolor it: it is deliberately borderless and binds to theme tokens.

anatomy.description: The active model name (the `value` prop, default "Default"); 11px/16px medium text bound to c-text.
12px ChevronDown in c-icon-secondary signalling the pill opens the model menu.

use_when: In the composer toolbar, to surface and change the active model/provider.
dont_use_when: You need the model list itself or selection handling — the menu is host-owned (PopoverMenu); this is only the trigger.
A bordered value selector inside a panel form — use Dropdown.

tokens.note: Height h-[24px], gap-[2px], padding pl-[8px]/pr-[4px], label 11px/16px weight 550 tracking 0.055px, chevron size 12 strokeWidth 2, and disabled opacity-60 are hardcoded arbitrary values, not spacing/type tokens. No hex literal, so color and shape stay token-bound.

a11y.role: button (native <button type=button>; no explicit role attribute).
a11y.haspopup: aria-haspopup="menu" signals it opens the host-owned model menu.
a11y.label: aria-label="Model: {value}" names the control and announces the active model.
a11y.disabled: disabled attribute; onClick is suppressed and cursor-not-allowed/opacity-60 reflect it.
a11y.chevron: decorative glyph; the value text conveys the current model.
